CHAPTER VIII.
The Queen's Croquet-Ground


In the garden, three gardeners were hastily painting white roses red
to avoid the Queen's wrath, having planted the wrong color tree. A
grand procession arrived, including the King and Queen of Hearts,
who ordered the gardeners beheaded, though Alice hid them in a
flower-pot to save them.

The Queen invited Alice to play croquet using live flamingoes as
mallets and hedgehogs as balls, in a chaotic game where the Queen
constantly shouted "Off with his head!" Alice spoke with the
Cheshire Cat again, whose disembodied grinning head caused an
argument between the King, Queen, and executioner about whether a
head with no body could be cut off at all.
